item_title: Tokenised Deposits in 2026: Banking Services, Stablecoin Competition, and the Status of Programmable Commercial Bank Money
description: Tokenised deposit services in 2026 are moving from research into bank pilots and early client propositions. The status is still pre-scale, but the direction is clear: commercial bank money is being adapted for programmable settlement, digital wallets, stablecoin interoperability, and tokenised capital markets.
